grade_reason: He talks about AI (his 2026 Senate campaign platform has an AI policy page focused on beating China, protecting children and a Geneva Convention for military AI), but no dated statement since 1 January 2025 acknowledging catastrophic risk from AI was found. His strongest risk remarks (AI 'as dangerous as nuclear weapons') are from 2023 and about military use.
